notes: Provisional: no claim comes from this record alone.
Sonnet is a reference, not ground truth. The cheaper grader is from the same family, so their errors may be correlated and agreement may flatter it.

Entry 53's rule: the cheaper grader is 'clearly worse' only if the interval of its agreement with Sonnet minus the local judge's lies wholly below zero. Claims the grader did not grade are left out of every figure and listed.
Intervals resample whole cases (claims of one case move together); per-set figures rest on fewer cases.
In the saved rows `claim_supported` is the local verdict and `cloud_supported` is Sonnet's; checked against the records' grounded_rate and cloud_grounded_rate.

grader.prompt: the local judge's rubric text, e2-v1

sampling.rule: Pool: every claim in the two JC records with both a local and a Sonnet grade. Strata: set (old, new) by system (single, team_changed). Each stratum gets a share of the sample in proportion to its size (largest remainder); inside a stratum claims are drawn at random with a fixed seed. The sample is graded in a seeded random order, so a run that stops early has graded a random part of it.

run.note: calls_made counts this process's calls to the client; the shared counter also moves for other work

agreement_difference.what: haiku agreement minus local agreement, each with Sonnet
